Job Summary The Senior Advisor, Trade Compliance, serves as the Company's principal non-attorney subject matter resource for import compliance execution and supports the integration of the Company's import and export compliance activities. This role has primary responsibility for carrying out the Company's import compliance program in daily practice, including customs entry oversight, tariff classification, valuation, country-of-origin determinations, and recordkeeping, and for translating program requirements into workable procedures for the business. Reporting to the Lead Counsel, Import and Trade Compliance, the Senior Advisor, Trade Compliance, will work closely with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and outside trade advisors and will serve as a day-to-day technical resource on customs and trade regulatory questions arising across the enterprise. The Senior Advisor, Trade Compliance, will support import program governance, CTPAT activities, regulatory filings and responses to U.S. Customs and Border Protection, special duty programs, audit remediation, and ERP and trade technology modernization initiatives. Position Overview Your Key Responsibilities may include: Import Compliance Program Support Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of the Company's import compliance policies, procedures, and standards. Support the network of Import Compliance Single Points of Contact (SPOCs) across Supply Chain, Commercial, and other business units and functions. Determine and maintain import record retention requirements and documentation management processes for import transactions. Track audit remediation items and entry changes through closure. Customs Operations and Broker Oversight Review customs broker entries for accuracy and completeness and engage with outside vendors on entry quality. Perform customs broker oversight, including broker surveys, periodic reviews, and adherence to the Company's broker management procedures. Support filings and responses to U.S. Customs and Border Protection, including responses to CF-28 requests for information and CF-29 notices, post summary corrections, and protests. Support CTPAT program activities, including annual audit preparation and evidence collection. Support administration of Section 232 and Section 301 special duty programs. Support tax optimization initiatives involving free trade agreements, Chapter 98, duty drawback, and foreign trade zones. Support IEEPA-related refund and duty recovery efforts. Supply Chain and Commercial Support Engage with Supply Chain to collect documentation needed for customs entries and to answer questions from brokers. Provide practical guidance to Supply Chain and Commercial regarding planned imports and cross-border transactions. Support Supply Chain on logistics issues that implicate customs compliance. Export Compliance and Technology Integration Support alignment between the import and export compliance programs. Support ERP implementation and configuration changes affecting trade compliance. Communicates Effectively: Invites dialogue to gain a shared understanding and influences with confidence to drive performance and achieve business results Partners Collaboratively: Builds strong relationships based on trust and seeks opportunities to collaborate across the matrix/organizational boundaries to achieve business goals Drives Performance: Delivers results through realistic planning to accomplish goals Basic Requirements: Legally authorized to work in the United States. Experience preparing and reviewing customs documentation, including entry summaries and supporting records. Working knowledge of: U.S. customs laws and regulations Customs valuation and tariff classification Import recordkeeping requirements CBP entry, post-entry, and enforcement processes Experience working directly with customs brokers and supporting responses to CBP inquiries. Strong organizational, project management, written communication, and stakeholder engagement skills. Ability to effectively balance regulatory risk management with business objectives. Preferred Requirements: Licensed Customs Broker, Certified Customs Specialist, or similar trade compliance designation. Working knowledge of export control and sanctions regulations. Experience supporting CTPAT programs, customs audits, prior disclosures, and government trade enforcement matters. Experience with non-U.S. customs and logistics. Experience with ERP systems, customs automation platforms, and other trade compliance technologies. Experience supporting multinational organizations with complex supply chain and global operations. Experience managing customs brokers, freight forwarders, and other third-party trade service providers. Experience developing and delivering trade compliance training to business stakeholders. Experience in the energy or industrial sector. Apply By: Oct 7, 2026 Sponsorship: ConocoPhillips’ sponsorship for employment authorization in the U.S. is NOT available for this position. Supporting and Building Financial Security : Competitive base pay, annual performance bonuses, and retirement savings plans. jobs.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Adoption, Innovation, and Transformation (AIT) team within OpenAI for Government helps government organizations turn OpenAI products into durable capabilities and measurable mission impact. We work alongside government leaders and public servants to move from exploration to confident, responsible, organization-wide use of AI, including our Cyber and Daybreak capabilities. Our work combines strategic communications, hands-on enablement, adoption strategy, deployment support, and community building, tailored to government missions and operating environments. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Cyber Enablement Lead to help government cyber professionals turn Daybreak’s capabilities into stronger defenses and measurable mission outcomes. This role combines technical credibility, hands-on teaching, strategic communication, and cross-functional leadership. You will own Daybreak’s government product enablement strategy and personally design and deliver the training that brings it to life. Your work will span audience research, curriculum design, recorded demonstrations and courses, hands-on workshops, executive briefings, and cyber councils. You will work directly with U.S. and international government cyber leaders to translate frontier AI capabilities into practical workflows that address operational challenges. You will also partner with the cyber product team, bringing customer feedback, deployment challenges, and adversarial context into product development. Your work will help shape best practices for adopting and deploying our cyber tools, strengthen government cyber defenses, and inform the direction of these capabilities. You will engage across the government cybersecurity ecosystem, including Authorizing Officials (AOs), CISOs, cyber operators, developers, and senior executives. Practitioners need practical proficiency; executives need a strategic understanding of our cyber products, their value, and their implications for mission and risk. Success means demonstrated capability, sustained adoption, and better cyber outcomes. This role is based in Washington, D.C. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. Travel and regular work from government customer sites are required. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Set the vision and own the execution of Daybreak’s government enablement strategy, from audience research and learning objectives to curriculum, delivery, and measurable mission impact. - Serve as a trusted cyber ambassador for OpenAI, leading substantive conversations about our tools and capabilities with U.S. and international government leaders, customers, and the broader cyber community. - Help government leaders understand and respond to AI’s changing cyber landscape through executive briefings, public speaking, and thought leadership grounded in operational experience. - Personally lead technical training, live demonstrations, hands-on workshops, and executive conversations that help AOs, CISOs, cyber operators, developers, and senior leaders apply Daybreak to their work. - Bring frontline experience into product development. Serve as a key point of contact for Daybreak Blue and Red, translating user feedback, deployment friction, and unmet mission needs into actionable product recommendations. - Create practical learning materials, including scripts, recorded demonstrations, interactive labs, digital courses, videos, facilitator guides, and playbooks. - Convene and lead our cyber councils, bringing leaders and practitioners into candid conversations that surface hard questions, share field lessons, and build a community of practice. - Deliver tailored engagements for specialist teams and repeatable learning programs that equip thousands of practitioners to use Daybreak effectively. - Translate frontier capabilities into practical government workflows across the cybersecurity lifecycle, connecting Daybreak’s applications and deployment requirements to challenges such as critical infrastructure security and defense of critical networks. - Develop practical guidance for human-machine teaming in cyber, including where AI adds value, where human judgment is essential, and how teams validate results and act responsibly. - Coordinate across product, security, deployment, and customer teams to address adoption barriers and keep enablement technically accurate, operationally relevant, and current as capabilities and requirements evolve. - Assess demonstrated proficiency, track sustained adoption, and use evidence of stronger cyber performance and mission outcomes to improve programs. 회사 소개
쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다.
쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다.
대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다.
보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.
팀
소개
로켓페이 CS Operations Specialist는 간편결제 및 정산 서비스에서 발생하는 운영 이슈를 선제적으로 진단하고, 데이터 기반으로 서비스 구조와 프로세스를 개선하는 핵심 직무입니다. 단순 1차 고객 응대를 넘어, VOC 항목화와 데이터 수치화를 통해 문제의 심각도를 판단하고 프로덕트/개발팀이 즉시 실행 가능한 형태로 솔루션을 제시합니다. 쿠팡의 체계적인 시스템과 툴을 활용해 전사 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며, 서비스 변경에 따른 영향도를 사전에 예측하여 안정적인 고객 경험을 만들어갑니다.
업무내용
고객 문의와 VOC 데이터를 영역 및 유형별로 분류하고, 주요 이슈와 개선 포인트를 정리합니다.
VOC 데이터와 운영 현황을 바탕으로 문제의 빈도와 고객 영향을 파악하고, 개선이 필요한 안건을 유관 부서에 공유합니다.
프로덕트 변경이나 신규 기능 배포 시 예상되는 고객 문의를 확인하고, 상담 가이드와 에스컬레이션 프로세스를 준비합니다.
위탁 상담사 및 ERE팀이 원활하게 업무를 수행할 수 있도록 운영 가이드를 제공하고, 주요 에스컬레이션 이슈의 해결을 지원합니다.
BTS(Jira), Wiki 등의 협업 도구를 활용해 운영 이슈와 업무 프로세스를 문서화하고 체계적으로 관리합니다.
프로덕트, 개발, 영업 등 유관 부서와 협업하여 고객 경험과 운영 프로세스의 개선을 지원합니다.

CS, CX 또는 Operations 관련 실무 경험을 5년 이상 보유하신 분
고객 문의나 VOC 데이터를 분류하고 주요 이슈를 파악해본 경험이 있으신 분
프로덕트, 개발, 영업 등 유관 부서와 협업하여 업무를 진행해본 경험이 있으신 분
서비스 정책과 운영 프로세스를 이해하고, 변경 사항에 맞춰 상담 또는 운영 가이드를 준비해본 경험이 있으신 분
Jira, Wiki, Confluence 등 프로젝트 및 이슈 관리 도구를 사용해본 경험이 있으신 분
Zendesk, Genesys 등 CS 솔루션이나 고객센터 시스템을 사용 또는 운영해본 경험이 있으신 분
우대
사항

플로우차트, 화면 캡처, 기능 정의서 등 다양한 방식으로 운영 이슈를 정리해본 경험이 있으신 분
위탁 고객센터의 상담 가이드 제작, 에스컬레이션 운영 또는 QA 모니터링 경험이 있으신 분
데이터를 활용해 반복적인 고객 문의나 운영 문제를 개선해본 경험이 있으신 분
변화하는 환경에 유연하게 대응하며, 맡은 업무를 꼼꼼하게 마무리하시는 분
전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.

본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.

jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
You will oversee electrical contractors and crews building electrical infrastructure for SpaceXAI's Memphis Data Center — including underground duct banks, high-voltage and medium-voltage systems, power distribution, grounding, lighting, and process power for mission-critical facilities. If you thrive on hands-on leadership, complex industrial electrical construction, and contributing to high-impact AI infrastructure, join us to help deliver one of the most advanced data centers in the world.
This is a full-time, onsite role based in Memphis, Tennessee, with relocation required depending on additional construction locations within the US.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Oversee and coordinate electrical installations including underground duct banks, conduits, cable pulling, terminations, switchgear, transformers, generators, UPS systems, PDUs, and grounding for SpaceXAI Data Centers.
Manage and schedule electrical contractors, subcontractors, and on-site crews to deliver project milestones on time and to SpaceXAI's exacting quality and reliability standards.
Ensure all contractors adhere to electrical scope, delivering high-integrity power systems critical to data center uptime and operational readiness.
Monitor daily progress of electrical construction, maintaining detailed logs, red-line drawings, and as-built documentation for power infrastructure.
Develop and enforce aggressive construction schedules while keeping the project on time and within budget.
Champion and enforce SpaceXAI's safety program, building a zero-incident culture across all teams working around energized equipment, excavations, and heavy electrical installations.
Supervise foremen and electrical crews, fostering teamwork and accountability in a high-stakes mission-critical environment.
Proactively resolve on-site challenges — material delays, technical conflicts, sequencing issues, and coordination with other trades — with a strong focus on electrical system reliability and code compliance.
Conduct regular site inspections to verify compliance with local regulations, electrical codes, safety protocols, and SpaceXAI's stringent quality standards.
Prepare and present clear progress reports, electrical construction metrics, and risk updates to senior leadership.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
3+ years managing electrical construction teams with strong emphasis on large-scale industrial or mission-critical electrical projects.
3+ years of direct hands-on experience in electrical installations including underground duct banks, high-voltage/medium-voltage systems, cable pulling/terminations, switchgear, and power distribution — ideally on industrial processes or heavy power projects.
High school diploma or equivalency certificate.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Postsecondary diploma or degree in construction management, electrical engineering, or related field.
Proven track record supervising electrical construction for data centers, hyperscale facilities, or similar mission-critical environments.
Familiarity with Memphis-area building codes, electrical regulations (NEC, NFPA 70E), and industrial permitting.
Experience with construction management software (Procore, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, MS Project, etc.) on complex infrastructure projects.
Deep knowledge of electrical construction critical paths, sequencing, and coordination with mechanical/civil trades through commissioning.
Strong understanding of data center electrical specifications, redundancy requirements, grounding, and power systems designed for 24/7 operation.
Demonstrated ability to lead diverse crews under tight deadlines while maintaining collaboration and safety.
Expert-level commitment to electrical safety (NFPA 70E, LOTO, arc flash) and history of building strong safety cultures on regulated sites.
Excellent problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills for technically complex electrical scenarios.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Project) for reporting and scheduling.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS
Subject to pre-employment drug screening and random drug and alcohol testing.
Subject to pre-employment and annual post-employment background checks.
Comfortable working in industrial environments with exposure to noise, heavy equipment, excavations, and energized electrical systems.
Available for evenings and weekends as site operational needs dictate.
Ability to lift 25+ lbs and perform physically demanding tasks in outdoor/tight conditions.
If you are a hands-on electrical construction leader who excels in high-stakes, mission-critical environments and is ready to drive the delivery of groundbreaking AI infrastructure, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the DACH region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s defence business across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and the wider European region, with Germany as the main focus. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's defence and security organisations adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence and the public sector. These customers need AI that runs on their own infrastructure, often air-gapped or at the tactical edge, and that can handle classified information. SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits: - Technical experts in the field - Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues - Product evangelists of Cohere technology - Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products. In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers. You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams. A typical day at Cohere might include: - Leading the technical talk track on customer calls. - Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments, including on-prem, air-gapped and sovereign cloud setups that meet German and EU requirements such as GDPR, BSI C5 and the EU AI Act. - Designing for classified and disconnected environments (VS-NfD and above, air-gapped, DDIL and tactical edge), together with the customer's IT security and accreditation teams. - Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology. - Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption. - Translating defence and operational requirements into AI use cases, from logistics, maintenance and training to intelligence analysis and staff work. - Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack - Owning the technical response of RFPs and public tenders, including defence procurement, from security questionnaires to mapping the customer's requirements specification (Lastenheft) to our solution. - Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere. - Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs. - Working closely with our partners (system integrators, defence companies and sovereign cloud providers), who lead many of the larger deals in Germany, to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers. This might be for you if you have some of the following: - 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles where you both built and advised, such as consulting data scientist, forward deployed engineer, deployment strategist, or solutions architect, taking AI or data solutions from executive problem framing to production. - A passion for Agentic AI, and a practical understanding of where LLMs deliver value in production, and where they don't. - Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, retrieval etc.) and the ability to design evaluation frameworks for customer pilots. - Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences. - You thrive in ambiguity and can put high-impact structure and processes in place where none exist. - Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools - Experience in or with the defence sector, e.g. in the Bundeswehr (including reserve service), at a defence company, in federal IT or at NATO, and a deep understanding of how defence organisations buy and run IT. - Eligible and willing to undergo a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung under the SÜG, Ü2 or higher). An existing clearance is a strong plus. - Preferred: experience in the German defence market, e.g. at a system integrator or consultancy, or working on RFPs and public tenders. - Must have: Professional fluency in English and German (C1 or higher, verhandlungssicher) Please note: for this role we are open to a range of experience levels, from Associate to Staff-level Individual Contributors (ICs). Experience level stated is a bare minimum. We also welcome and support employees who actively serve in the Bundeswehr reserve. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

jobs.description: Application deadline: Oct 4, 2026 This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges. The Applied AI Solutions Architecture team within AWS is seeking a hands-on, customer-obsessed Solutions Architect to accelerate customer adoption of Amazon Connect's AI capabilities. This role is part of the AI Velocity Team — a service-specific approach that assigns dedicated advisory and hands-on development resources directly to customers to achieve production-ready outcomes in weeks instead of months. As an Applied AI Solutions Architect, you will be embedded with customers to help them prepare their Amazon Connect implementations for production by focusing on three critical pillars of agentic AI: Model Selection — Guiding customers through evaluating and selecting the right foundation models (via Amazon Bedrock) for their contact center use cases, balancing latency, accuracy, cost, and compliance requirements. Prompt Configuration — Designing, testing, and optimizing AI prompts and system instructions for Amazon Connect AI agents, including self-service agents, answer recommendation agents, and custom orchestrator agents. Tool Configuration — Architecting and building the tool integrations (APIs, Lambda functions, data connectors, knowledge bases) that agentic AI systems use to take actions on behalf of customers and agents — including configuring MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for standardized tool discovery and invocation, and enabling A2A (Agent-to-Agent) communication patterns for multi-agent orchestration across enterprise systems. A critical dimension of this role is Customer Data Readiness — assessing, preparing, and structuring customer data assets so that AI agents can reliably access, retrieve, and act on the right information. You will help customers evaluate their data landscape, identify gaps, establish data pipelines, and ensure their knowledge bases, CRMs, and backend systems are AI-ready before agents go live. You will work at the intersection of contact center operations and applied AI, helping customers move from proof-of-concept to pre-production for their Amazon Connect + Unlimited AI deployments. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role — you will write code, build integrations, configure agents, and pair-program with customer engineering teams. Willingness to travel up to 25-40% for on-site customer engagements Key job responsibilities Customer Engagement: Lead technical discovery sessions with customer teams to understand business requirements, existing contact center architecture, and AI readiness. Translate findings into actionable implementation plans. Customer Data Readiness: Conduct data readiness assessments to evaluate the quality, accessibility, structure, and governance of customer data assets (CRMs, knowledge bases, ticketing systems, order management, etc.). Identify data gaps, recommend remediation strategies, and help customers build the data foundation required for effective AI agent tool use and RAG-powered responses. Agentic AI Implementation: Design and configure agentic AI solutions within Amazon Connect, including AI agent creation, AI prompt engineering, model selection, guardrail configuration, and tool/action integration. MCP Server Configuration: Design and deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that expose customer tools, data sources, and APIs in a standardized format — enabling AI agents to dynamically discover and invoke capabilities across the customer's technology stack. A2A (Agent-to-Agent) Integration: Architect Agent-to-Agent communication patterns that allow Amazon Connect AI agents to collaborate with specialized agents across the enterprise (e.g., billing agents, order management agents, IT support agents), enabling multi-agent workflows that span organizational boundaries. Integration Development: Build serverless integrations using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, and scripting (Python, Node.js) to connect Amazon Connect AI agents with customer data systems (CRMs, ERPs, databases, knowledge bases). Cloud Data Access: Architect secure access patterns to cloud-based data systems (Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon RDS, Amazon S3, Amazon OpenSearch, Amazon Kendra/Knowledge Bases for Bedrock) to power AI agent tool use and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Pre-Production Validation: Guide customers through testing, evaluation, and validation of AI agent performance against defined success criteria before production deployment. Knowledge Sharing: Create reusable artifacts (reference architectures, implementation guides, sample code, prompt libraries, data readiness checklists) that scale best practices across the Connect SA community and partner ecosystem. Service Team Collaboration: Provide feedback to Amazon Connect and Amazon Bedrock product teams based on real-world customer implementations, contributing to product roadmap prioritization. A day in the life Pair-programming with customer developers to build and test AI agent configurations Designing prompt strategies and evaluating model performance across different foundation models Configuring MCP servers to expose customer APIs, databases, and tools in a standardized format for agent consumption Designing A2A workflows where Amazon Connect agents hand off to or collaborate with specialized agents across the customer's enterprise Configuring knowledge bases and data connectors for RAG-powered agent responses Conducting architecture reviews and providing prescriptive guidance for production readiness Documenting implementation patterns and contributing to the team's knowledge base Participating in weekly syncs with Connect service teams to share customer feedback and product insights About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

.

Our industry and business are continually evolving and fast-paced, providing numerous opportunities to learn and hone your skills. We work hard, but we also like to have fun, and believe that we provide a great place to come to work each day to pursue your passions.
The Challenge
We are seeking a mid-level Systems Engineer II with a focus on platform and monitoring systems to support and optimize our enterprise data pipeline and monitoring infrastructure. In this role, you will be a key administrator for a powerful suite of tools—Splunk, Cribl, Datadog, and Grafana—ensuring data flows efficiently and users have the access they need.
What You’ll Take On
Platform & User Management: Act as a primary administrator for our monitoring ecosystem, handling user onboarding, access controls, permissions, and group management across Splunk, Datadog, Cribl, and Grafana.
Data Pipeline Configuration: Use Cribl and other tools to stream, route, and filter log data. When necessary, apply JavaScript to transform and reshape data payloads as they move through the pipeline.
Querying & Dashboarding: Write SQL and platform-specific query languages to build reliable alerts, monitor data integrity, and create impactful dashboards.
System Administration: Use the Linux command line (CLI) to troubleshoot agents, manage configurations, and handle day-to-day platform maintenance.
Cross-Functional Support: Partner with internal teams to ensure their logging and metrics needs are met, assisting them with onboarding data sources and troubleshooting platform issues.
What You Bring
3+ years of experience administering enterprise software platforms, monitoring tools, or data systems.
Solid, hands-on experience with at least two of our primary platforms: Splunk, Cribl, Datadog, or Grafana.
Comfortable navigating the command line (CLI), with SQL proficiency and a working knowledge of using scripting languages for data manipulation.
Experience managing user roles, permissions (RBAC), and access policies within SaaS or enterprise environments.

Great Company Culture
. Ranked as one of the most creative and innovative places to work, creativity, innovation, efficiency, diversity and philanthropy are among the core tenets of our organization and are integral drivers of our continued success.
Growth
: As a global entertainment company, we pride ourselves on creating environments where employees are encouraged to be themselves, inquisitive, collaborative and to grow within and around the company.
Work Hard, Play Hard.
Our employees bond, blow-off steam, and flex some creative muscles – through corporate boot camp classes, company parties, game release events, monthly socials, and team challenges.

. Medical (HSA & FSA), dental, vision, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan, commuter benefits, in-house wellness program, broad learning & development opportunities, a charitable giving platform with company match and more!
Perks
. Fitness allowance, employee discount programs, free games & events and stocked pantries.
